text_block_list.text:
The last stage of my first three years
with Gold
Ship has arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The time to conquer the Arima Kinen has
arrived
once again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unlike a race, life isn't a clear shot to
the end.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
It's got mountains to climb, valleys to
cross, rivers
to raft, and in the end, it all
leads to the ocean.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Sometimes, gravity might get thrown out
of
whack and fling you into outer space.
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But that's no biggie. The water cycle
never sleeps,
and that means you'll
always end up in the ocean
again, no
matter what!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Um, what the heck are you going on
about?
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that speech is Golshi's way of
expressing
enthusiasm.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Holy tectonics! Didn't expect you both
here!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
If we compare today's race to Earth's
topology,
it'd be on the scale of a huge
mountain―no! It'd
be up there with the
Japanese Alps!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
But I'll conquer it just the same. Just like
I'll
conquer the two of you and return to
the ocean!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Our rivalry and the battles it has yielded
have
been pivotal in my own personal
growth.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I shall bring the fruits of my labor to
bear in
today's race.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And just FYI, I'm, like, a whole new
Umamusume
compared to before.
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
I'm so absolutely, totally, one hundred
percent
winning today!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! The fire burning inside you
both is hot
as magma, and I'm right there
with you!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
Let's burn the track so hot it melts into
lava!
text_block_list.name: Голд Шип

text_block_list.text:
The curtains rise on the ultimate race of
the
Twinkle Series!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
